users.description: Account able to sign in. MVP has exactly one row (username/password hardcoded per AGENTS.md), but the table exists so multiple users are possible later.

boards.description: A Kanban board owned by a user. MVP creates exactly one per user.

board_columns.description: A column on a board (e.g. Backlog, In Progress). Named board_columns, not columns, to avoid the reserved-word collision.

position.description: 0-based order of this column within its board

cards.description: A card belonging to a column.

position.description: 0-based order of this card within its column

relationships: users.id -> boards.user_id (one user has many boards; MVP: exactly one)
boards.id -> board_columns.board_id (one board has many columns)
board_columns.id -> cards.column_id (one column has many cards)
